name: Sukowati field, Bojonegoro (Pertamina EP, with JOGMEC and JAPEX)
description: pilot: about 500 t CO2 huff-and-puff into well SKW-18 over 7 days

sources.note: ChemAnalyst, JAPEX and partners launch CO2 injection test at Sukowati, 18 October 2024 (read 28 October 2026); October 2026 status from Pertamina EP Cepu statement via suaradesa.co, 14 October 2026

notes: Status per card source: first CO2 injection 7 December 2023 (500 t huff-and-puff pilot into well SKW-18); inter-well CO2 injection field trial started 8 October 2024 under an August 2024 joint study by Pertamina EP, JAPEX and JOGMEC; full-scale application is still being evaluated by the joint study and Pertamina EP Cepu (operator of the adjacent Jambaran Tiung Biru field) as of October 2026, with commercial CO2-EOR not yet running
